author: RightSide
body:
Please can you change the limit of players to start a game. On Avicus normally theres only 1 nebula game going on because trying to start off a new game you have to have like 12 players which is far too many! If it was made back to 4 or 6 this is a suitable amount so there's more games going on at the sometime! Because if a map comes on you don't like you can switch games instead of going on a different server to play the games you want! This is a good feature also for the people who aren't premium.

Thanks I hope this is taken into consideration Element.
